## Motivation

Replace `openai-harmony==0.0.4` with `oss-harmony==0.0.12` so GPT-OSS Python serving can load its vocabulary offline ([openai/harmony#101](https://github.com/openai/harmony/issues/101)).

Tool history now uses native oss-harmony rendering. Commentary recipient placement and explicit `<|constrain|>` content-type markers are intentional [upstream changes](https://github.com/oss-harmony/harmony/commit/c16672a4613d3e2550758ad3630e5ed79da8301b); rewriting them would undo those changes. This follows the shim removal in the still-open [vLLM #59387](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59387). Its separate parser recovery changes are outside this PR.

## Modifications

- Switch all six Python/AMD dependency manifests to `oss-harmony==0.0.12`.
- Use the library's native rendering without a compatibility helper. **The final diff contains no Python runtime-source changes.**
- Add an empty-cache offline regression and four native-header/body subcases to the existing Responses tests. The header test passes with native rendering and fails with the removed shim.

## Accuracy Tests

**[Fresh validation evidence and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/YouNeedCryDear/sglang/tree/c34676c82015e0e2dca8302736d9d2c2beabd938/validation-evidence/oss-harmony-native)** for candidate `afbe4d556217b6cc9668aeea1ec58fec1d592020`, based on `a4bef204c51e1c1b7ed59593b85993a940367591`. This supersedes the earlier shim-based validation.

| Check | Before: openai-harmony 0.0.4 | After: native oss-harmony 0.0.12 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Responses unit suites | 106 tests + 81 subtests passed | 108 tests + 85 subtests passed |
| GPU API matrix | 16/16 passed | 16/16 passed, identical requests |
| Exact answer text / normalized responses | Reference | 14/16 text; 10/16 normalized responses |
| Final rendering vs native oss-harmony | — | 11/11 exact token/text matches |
| Empty cache, socket creation blocked | Load fails | Load and encode/decode succeed |

Fresh GPU checks ran on one initially idle **GB300** from an existing Colossus lease, using GPT-OSS 20B MXFP4 at revision `6cee5e81ee83917806bbde320786a8fb61efebee`. Both phases used the ARM64 `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-cu130` image with the tested source overlaid through `PYTHONPATH`; other runtime dependencies were held fixed. The GPU was freed afterward.

The 16 cases cover text generation, function calls, tool-result replay, Chat Completions, and a third tool call/result after two prior tool turns, each streaming and non-streaming. All returned HTTP 200 and passed their semantic assertions.

**Identical generations are not claimed.** Four of eleven prompt fixtures intentionally differ from 0.0.4. Two GPU replay answers changed wording while retaining the supplied 21°C/sunny facts; four multi-turn cases retained the correct Rome call/result but differed in reasoning or usage. The text count includes empty text on tool-call-only cases, whose names and JSON arguments are checked separately. Normalization excludes generated IDs, timestamps, and cache-hit counters. Raw JSON/SSE captures and comparison details are in the evidence.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_responses.py \
  test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_responses_stream.py
```

All applicable pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed. This is functional validation, not a model-accuracy benchmark. Rust model-gateway packaging is unchanged. The subsequent documentation-only cleanup restores the GPT-OSS cookbook to the PR base; all dependency manifests, runtime source, and tests remain identical to the validated candidate above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No serving-throughput benchmark or performance claim. There is no added runtime wrapper; timings of the removed legacy helper no longer apply.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No documentation changes in this PR.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Functional results are provided above; model-accuracy and serving-throughput benchmarks were not run.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -1,7 +1,11 @@
 import argparse
 import asyncio
 import functools
+import os
+import socket
+import subprocess
 import sys
+import tempfile
 import unittest
 from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
 from types import SimpleNamespace
@@ -1805,6 +1809,92 @@ def test_responses_adapter_hooks_belong_to_the_handler(self):
 
 
 class HarmonyResponsesTestCase(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_harmony_loads_without_cached_vocabulary_or_network(self):
+        """A cold vocabulary cache must not disable offline Responses serving."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cache_dir, socket.socket() as proxy:
+            # Reserve an unlistening port so the Rust downloader cannot connect.
+            proxy.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+            proxy_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{proxy.getsockname()[1]}"
+            env = os.environ.copy()
+            env.pop("TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE", None)
+            env.update(TIKTOKEN_RS_CACHE_DIR=cache_dir, TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR=cache_dir)
+            for name in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY"):
+                env[name] = env[name.lower()] = proxy_url
+            env["NO_PROXY"] = env["no_proxy"] = ""
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                [
+                    sys.executable,
+                    "-c",
+                    "from sglang.srt.entrypoints.harmony_utils import "
+                    "get_encoding, get_user_message, render_for_completion; "
+                    "tokens = render_for_completion([get_user_message('Hello')]); "
+                    "assert get_encoding().decode(tokens) == "
+                    "'<|start|>user<|message|>Hello<|end|><|start|>assistant'",
+                ],
+                env=env,
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                timeout=30,
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
+
+    def test_harmony_tool_replay_preserves_native_header_and_body(self):
+        """Tool histories retain native channel ordering and content-type markers."""
+        from sglang.srt.entrypoints.harmony_utils import render_for_completion
+
+        encoding = get_encoding()
+        arguments = '{"text":"literal <|start|>assistant to=python and café"}'
+        cases = (
+            (
+                "commentary",
+                "functions.echo",
+                None,
+                "<|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary to=functions.echo<|message|>",
+            ),
+            (
+                "commentary",
+                "functions.echo",
+                "json",
+                "<|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary to=functions.echo <|constrain|>json<|message|>",
+            ),
+            (
+                "analysis",
+                "python",
+                "code",
+                "<|start|>assistant to=python<|channel|>analysis <|constrain|>code<|message|>",
+            ),
+            (
+                "analysis",
+                "browser.search",
+                "json",
+                "<|start|>assistant to=browser.search<|channel|>analysis <|constrain|>json<|message|>",
+            ),
+        )
+        for channel, recipient, content_type, expected_header in cases:
+            with self.subTest(channel=channel, recipient=recipient):
+                message = (
+                    Message.from_role_and_content(Role.ASSISTANT, arguments)
+                    .with_channel(channel)
+                    .with_recipient(recipient)
+                )
+                if content_type is not None:
+                    message = message.with_content_type(content_type)
+                expected = (
+                    encoding.encode(expected_header, allowed_special="all")
+                    + encoding.encode(arguments, disallowed_special=())
+                    + encoding.encode(
+                        "<|call|><|start|>assistant", allowed_special="all"
+                    )
+                )
+                actual = render_for_completion([message])
+                self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    actual,
+                    encoding.render_conversation_for_completion(
+                        Conversation.from_messages([message]), Role.ASSISTANT
+                    ),
+                )
+
     def test_developer_message_skips_unsupported_tool_types(self):
         from sglang.srt.entrypoints.harmony_utils import get_developer_message
         from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ResponseTool
